purpose: Suites that exist as npm scripts but run in no workflow lane, and Playwright configs that have no owning npm script at all. A debt register, not an exemption list: scripts/check-e2e-suite-wiring.mjs fails on any suite or config missing from here, and fails again on any entry that has since been wired, given a script, or deleted, so these lists can only shrink. suiteProtection records the strongest concrete event class for every E2E script; any change to that class fails the gate until the baseline is updated through an explicit reviewed change.
recordedBy: #2629 (epic #2285 Wave 2); configsWithoutScript added by #2891 (audit KEIKO-0077); suiteProtection added by #3120 (audits KEIKO-0151 and KEIKO-0256)
note: Every entry predates the gate that records it; none was added to silence a failure. Wiring one is a CI-minute decision owned by the suite area, not by this file. The creation date is in git history rather than duplicated here, where it could only drift. test:e2e:editor-perf is deliberate: it is driven by the D12 evidence regeneration flow (docs/qa/perf-evidence.md), not by a lane.
configsWithoutScriptNote: A config with no owning script is less runnable than a suite that merely runs in no lane: nothing can even name it, so the suites list above cannot see it. Each entry states why a script would be wrong today rather than merely absent. Adding the script is the fix; recording it here is the interim. Reasons are in configsWithoutScriptReasons, keyed by the same file name.

Issue #2483 — drives code-task-authority.spec.ts against a staged, approved real OpenCode payload discovered through the production macOS dev-lane path, with no resolver/supervisor/KEIKO_OPENCODE_REAL_* seam to substitute. It requires that payload staged on the machine, so it is operator-run on a prepared checkout; a hosted runner has nothing to discover and the script could only ever fail.
human-loop-1405.spec.ts renders a hand-authored HTML replica instead of driving the real app or the real AgentGateCard (open finding KEIKO-0140 / GEN-TEST-E2E-003). Giving it a script and a lane would gate on a fixture already known not to exercise the component it claims to cover. The script lands when that finding is repaired or the suite is rewritten.
